title: Post-100 depth batch 06
notes: Bounded zero-history hardware-wallet depth batch under Issue #239. Only first-party launch-history claims with preserved source precision are included. NGRAVE is recorded as a ready-to-ship announcement rather than general availability; Cypherock preserves private-beta scope; SecuX preserves month precision for its first official V20 sale.

events.title: NGRAVE announced ZERO was ready to ship
events.description: NGRAVE announced that its ZERO hardware wallet was ready to ship and would soon be in the hands of backers.
events.notes: This records the first-party ready-to-ship milestone only. It does not infer general retail availability or an exact first-customer delivery date.

events.title: Cypherock X1 launched in private beta
events.description: Cypherock states that the X1 hardware vault launched in private beta in 2022.
events.notes: The source establishes private beta in 2022 only. WLR does not convert this to general availability or infer a more precise date.

events.title: SecuX V20 recorded its first official sale at CES Las Vegas
events.description: SecuX states that its first official sale took place at CES Las Vegas in January 2019, where the V20 was sold to its first customer.
events.notes: The retrospective provides January 2019 month precision but no exact day, so WLR preserves month precision.

evidence.title: We are ready to Ship!
evidence.notes: First-party NGRAVE post dated 2021-11-02 states ZERO was ready to ship and would soon be in the hands of backers.

evidence.title: Cypherock Cover
evidence.notes: First-party Cypherock history states that Cypherock X1 launched in private beta in 2022.

evidence.title: SecuX 7th Anniversary: 7 Years of Innovation in Crypto and Digital Security
evidence.notes: First-party retrospective states SecuX's first official sale took place at CES Las Vegas in January 2019, with the V20 sold to its first customer.
